patch.summary: Fixed the crash that stopped the penguin demo: the sandbox's tensorflow-datasets lazily imports the `importlib_resources` backport, which isn't installed, so TFDS died while resolving the penguins dataset checksums path. The entry point now aliases the Python 3.11 stdlib `importlib.resources` (same `files()`/`abc.Traversable` API) when the backport is absent, and the backport is added to the example dependency manifests so a fresh install gets the real package. Note: the frontend bundle is still unbuilt in this sandbox (no `lit_nlp/client/build/default`, no node_modules, no yarn), so the server will bind port 5432 but `/` returns 404 until setup runs the documented `(cd lit_nlp; yarn && yarn build)` — that build needs node deps from the network and cannot be produced by editing the repo.
